the Dpp morphogens from the stripe are required for wing disc patterning and growth, at all times during wing disc development.

dpp is required for both patterning and growth of the Dpp stripe.

Dpp signaling is crucial for wing disc growth during the third instar larva stage and is required for growth of the posterior compartment of the wing disc.
dpp from the anterior compartment is required for growth and patterming of the Drosphila wing disc.
